answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 31764 Country: MU Title: Recitation of the Quran Question: Can the people present at the mayyat start reciting the Holy Quran before the deceased is given his ghusl? Answer ID: 31764 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 815/815/M=1432) It is makrooh to recite the holy Quran near the dead one before giving him ghusl. وكره قراءة القرآن عنده إلى تمام غسله الخ . (در مختار) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
